questions.title: Who will be appointed head of Syria’s National Security Bureau in July 2026?
questions.background: The National Security Bureau oversees Syria’s security agencies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official Syrian government announcement or reporting by the Syrian state news agency SANA identifying the person appointed head of the National Security Bureau during July 2026. Resolution Date : The date the appointment is publicly announced. Accepted Answer Format : The appointee’s full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Syria's Ba'athist National Security Bureau was dissolved after Bashar al-Assad's fall, and President Ahmed al-Sharaa established a National Security Council in March 2025 alongside a restructured General Intelligence Service (initially led by Anas Khattab, who became Interior Minister in spring 2025, and since May 2025 by Hussein al-Salama). If Damascus establishes or revives a National Security Bureau in July 2026 to coordinate security agencies, sitting General Intelligence chief Hussein al-Salama and Interior Minister/former spy chief Anas Khattab (al-Sharaa's top security architect) are the leading internal candidates, followed by Defense Minister Murhaf Abu Qasra, Chief of General Staff Ali Noureddine al-Naasan, and senior presidential/interior insider Ali Keda. Given Damascus's history of elevating lesser-known former HTS security commanders whose full names emerge only upon SANA announcement, a full 50% tail mass is left outside these five figures.

local_articles.title: Syrians optimistic but cautious as sanctions removal revives economic hopes
local_articles.snippet: Damascus, Syria – For many Syrians, the decades of rule by the al-Assad family – Hafez al-Assad from 1971 to 2000, then his son Bashar from 2000 to 2024 – were filled with oppression from the state and eventually more than a decade of civil war. But one of the most important legacies has been an economic one – the result of the sanctions imposed by a number of countries, led by the United States, that effectively froze Syria out of the international economic system. questions.title: Which country will the Trump administration target in its first invocation of Section 338 tariff powers by August 18, 2026?
questions.background: Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930 authorizes U.S. tariffs in response to discriminatory treatment of American commerce.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the country whose exports are targeted by the Trump administration's first invocation of Section 338 of the Tariff Act of 1930, announced on or before August 18, 2026. An announced tariff measure counts even if its effective date has not yet arrived. Use official U.S. announcements or contemporaneous reporting confirming the invocation. Resolution Date : 2026-08-18 Accepted Answer Format : Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.current_reasoning: After the Supreme Court struck down IEEPA tariffs on Feb. 20, 2026, the Trump administration imposed 10% global tariffs under Section 122—which expire after 150 days on July 24, 2026—while launching Section 301 probes on 16 manufacturing economies and keeping never-used Section 338 (up to 50% duties without investigation for 'discrimination' against U.S. commerce) 'on the table for discrete circumstances' per USTR Jamieson Greer. Because no specific target has been named as of June 24, probability is widely dispersed (38% outside the top 5). Top candidates are Canada (excluded from March 11 Section 301, acute June Gordie Howe Bridge clash, July 1 USMCA review, provincial U.S. liquor boycotts), China (major rival if Oct. 2025 truce frays), Brazil (previously hit with 50% IEEPA tariff, digital/trade disputes), France (Digital Services Tax), and India (intense tariff disputes if Greer's June 22-24 New Delhi talks stall before July 24).

questions.title: Who will succeed Oleksandr Syrskii as Ukraine's top military commander?
questions.background: Oleksandr Syrskii leads Ukraine's armed forces during the war against Russia.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : An official announcement by Ukraine's presidency or reliable contemporaneous reporting, including Al Jazeera. Resolution Condition : Resolve when Ukraine's president formally appoints a successor to Oleksandr Syrskii as the country's top military commander. Temporary or acting appointments do not count unless confirmed as permanent. Accepted Answer Format : The successor's full name.
questions.current_reasoning: Following Zelenskyy's Jan 2026 reshuffle (making Kyrylo Budanov Head of the Presidential Office and Mykhailo Fedorov Defense Minister), Zelenskyy stated he would next turn to resetting the Armed Forces, and June 12 LIGA.net reporting cited a Syrskyi–Fedorov rift over military transformation. Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi (Joint Forces Commander, former Ground Forces Commander) is Ukraine's leading reform-minded battlefield general, closely followed by Chief of the General Staff Andrii Hnatov (the current #2 officer publicly leading June 2026 reform messaging). Pavlo Palisa (Deputy Head of the Presidential Office for military affairs), Ground Forces Commander Hennadii Shapovalov, and Deputy Defense Minister / former Deputy C-in-C Yevhen Moisiuk round out the top five, with 19% reserved for other senior officers.

questions.title: If Typhoon Noul makes landfall in mainland China during July 2026, in which province will it do so?
questions.background: Landfall refers to the cyclone's centre crossing the coastline, rather than areas experiencing its wind or rain.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : China's National Meteorological Centre's official landfall report, including reliable news coverage quoting that report. Resolution : Resolve to the province containing the reported location of Typhoon Noul's mainland China landfall during July 2026. Accepted Answer Format : The province's name.
questions.current_reasoning: Typhoon Noul (12th named storm of 2026) is still weeks from genesis as of June 24, 2026, targeting mid-to-late July. Compared with early July, the subtropical high shifts further north in late July, and 2026's intensifying El Nino plus CMA's April 2026 warning of northward-moving midsummer typhoons tilt probabilities further toward East China (Zhejiang and Fujian) alongside climatological leader Guangdong. Hainan and Guangxi retain meaningful South China Sea probabilities, while 8% is left for Shandong, Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Liaoning.

questions.title: Which Indian state will have the highest reported death toll from monsoon floods and landslides as of August 5, 2026?
questions.background: India's annual monsoon can cause fatal floods and landslides across multiple states.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Resolve to the Indian state with the highest reported cumulative death toll from monsoon floods and landslides since July 1, 2026, according to official data cited in news reporting Resolution Date : August 5, 2026 Accepted Answer Format : The state's name
questions.current_reasoning: The cumulative tally resets on July 1, 2026 through August 5, 2026, covering peak southwest monsoon flash-flood and landslide season. Although IMD forecasts below-normal aggregate 2026 rainfall (92% of normal) under developing El Nino, both IMD and ICIMOD warn that short-burst cloudbursts and landslides remain severe, and MHA's June 15, 2026 NDRF pre-deployments concentrate heaviest in Himachal Pradesh (13 teams), Uttarakhand (13), Kerala (9), and Assam (8), with Northeast India already hit by extreme rain on June 22-24. Historical July-early August leaders (Himachal Pradesh, Assam, Uttarakhand, Kerala, Maharashtra) account for ~76%, leaving 24% across other vulnerable states (Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, Karnataka, Sikkim).

questions.title: Which NBA team will LeBron James choose for the 2026–27 season?
questions.background: This question concerns James's publicly announced team choice for the upcoming NBA season.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : James's public announcement of his team choice for the 2026–27 season during the 2026 offseason, corroborated by reputable news or sports reporting. Resolution Date : Resolve when James publicly announces that choice. A completed contract signing or appearance in a game is not required. Accepted Answer Format : The full name of the NBA team he chooses.
questions.current_reasoning: Major shift on Kalshi's $76M+ LeBron James next-team market between July 6 and July 9-10: SI.com (July 9) shows Cleveland Cavaliers slipping from 55-57% to 46% (despite extending Donovan Mitchell and Marc Stein still calling Cleveland the scenario to beat), while the Miami Heat surged from <10% (July 5) to 18% (July 8, AL.com) to 22% (July 9) after newly acquired Giannis Antetokounmpo welcomed teaming up, Ethan Skolnick reported Miami is open to giving Bronny James a two-way deal, and ESPN's Brian Windhorst placed Cleveland and Miami in 'their own category.' Golden State rebounded from 15% (July 8) to 18% (July 9) as Stephen Curry publicly pitched LeBron at the American Century Championship on July 9 (Straits Times July 10), though Washington's reluctance to trade Anthony Davis limits GSW's upside. Philadelphia spiked from 4.4% to 16% on July 8 after 76ers president Bob Myers pitched LeBron on Rich Paul's podcast (TIME/AL.com), then retraced behind GSW by July 9. Vig-adjusting July 9 Kalshi pricing with slight dampening against podcast volatility moves Cleveland 0.53 -> 0.45, Miami 0.12 -> 0.21 (#2), Warriors 0.18 -> 0.17, 76ers 0.07 -> 0.10, and Timberwolves 0.04 -> 0.03 (4% residual for Nuggets/Knicks/Spurs/Lakers).
